questions.stem: A patient presents with sudden-onset central chest pain. The 12-lead ECG shown was recorded on arrival. What is the single best interpretation of this ECG?
options: Normal sinus rhythm without acute ischaemic change

distractors: Anterior STEMI would primarily produce ST elevation in the anterior precordial leads rather than the inferior pattern shown.

lo: Recognise and localise acute myocardial infarction from a 12-lead ECG

image.caption: 12-lead ECG recorded on presentation.
